in_sanskrit.name: श्रीनिवास
in_sanskrit.meaning: Prosperity, abundance, or fortune (Shree) + dwelling place, abode (Nivas)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a dwelling place filled with prosperity, abundance, or fortune

in_hindi.name: श्रीनिवास
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रसर्द्ध वसती (prasarddha vasati) - the one who has a prosperous dwelling or abode

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீநிவாஸ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: உதவும் வசனம் (utavum vasanam) - the one who has a prosperous dwelling or abode

in_telugu.name: శ్రీనివాశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: పొదుపోదు దేశముదూర్ధు (podupodu desamudu) - the one who has a prosperous dwelling or abode

in_marathi.name: Shreenivas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of abundance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreenivas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shree is the Goddess of wealth and prosperity. Nivas means abode, residence, or dwelling. So Shreenivas refers to the abode of the Goddess of wealth.

in_bengali.name: Shreenivas
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of abundance
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shreenivas একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Shree is the Goddess of wealth and prosperity. Nivas means abode, residence, or dwelling. So Shreenivas refers to the abode of the Goddess of wealth.
